info.description: Represents the geometry, distance, and time of the shortest or fastest path between given start and end points.
info.title: BC Route Planner REST API

requests.description: Represents the turn-by-turn directions, geometry, distance, and time of the shortest path or fastest path between given start and end points
requests.name: Get the directions, path, distance and travel time between a series of geographic points
requests.note: Replace {{BC_ROUTE_PLANNER_REST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Get the directions, path, distance and travel time between a series of geographic points
